text_block_list.text:
Since Smart Falcon's classmate was running in a race,
we went to watch it together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! 1st place~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She was doing voluntary training until late every night.
Lately, she's been working super hard!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She's finally center for the concert after all.
I've gotta give her my full support after this too♪
We celebrated our friend's victory and waited for the Winning Live to start, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Is the concert start time delayed?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: She seemed fine when she crossed the finish line, so it can't be an injury, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about it...!
Trainer, let's go check it out!

Curious about how my victorious friend was doing,
I headed backstage, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
Did something happen, by any chance...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: W-Well, I got so nervous my legs started shaking...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nervous? But your run in the race earlier was so dignified and confident!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I was completely lost in the moment during the race, but...
suddenly, it feels like I've snapped back to reality..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm not good at singing or dancing, either...

It seems she's been in a state of confusion ever since crossing the finish line.
Fortunately, she doesn't appear to be injured or ill, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san, please take my place in the live show!
Please! You're great at concerts, right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No way... The audience is all
waiting for you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I... I just...
I'm so scared of getting on that stage...”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do...?
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can help you relax a little.
How about I go out there in your place?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! After showing us such an
amazing race, the Winning Live is bound to be awesome too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen.
Falco gets super nervous before concerts too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Falco-san too...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. No matter how many times I stand on stage,
I always get nervous in front of an audience."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “More than anything, though, I want the audience to be happy... Thinking about that just fires me right up.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Listen, hear those voices?
(WAAAAAAH...--!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
See?♪ You can hear the cheers, right?
It's because everyone's excited for your entrance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Listen, you can hear the clapping... Everyone is cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Everyone was cheering for me
the whole time, even during the race, wasn't that right...

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Falco-san!
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆
You'll be just fine! Good luck!

Sent off by Smart Falcon, she put on a splendid
Winning Live performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That stage was simply dazzling☆
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! As long as Falco has all her fans, I can push through anything, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? That won't do at all!
Falco can never be a replacement for someone else!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them has an irreplaceable charm...
That's what an Umadol is all about!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Still... but I...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Geez!
You're irreplaceable too, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's no substitute for you anywhere in the whole wide world!
You are you! Have some confidence!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Falco will stand on stage
with you as the MC☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But you're the star of the live show, after all! ☆

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san...
All right, I... I'll give it a shot!

Thanks to Smart Falcon's MCing, her friend was able
to relax, and the concert was a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Falco-san. Seeing everyone
cheering for me gave me so much courage!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll do my best with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ I'm gonna give it my all too!
Pushing each other to new heights as rivals is the Umadol way☆
